dedupe_keys.name: drincs2 0 national de facto wastewater reuse intake data

description: The DRINCS2.0 project publishes U.S. estimates of treated-wastewater contributions at surface-water drinking intakes. The Zenodo record contains a README pointing to the public interactive site, whose own page was opened and lists annual and monthly intake downloads in GeoJSON and shapefile form. Map layers depict stream dilution factor and intake de facto reuse. These spatial outputs can inform drinking-water exposure and source-dependency simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the DRINCS2.0 download product. Coverage is U.S. public-water intakes represented by the assessment, including small and large systems, not every actual molecule of wastewater in a sample. A limitation is that the site says intake locations are anonymised and rounded to about one kilometre and warns that results may contain errors. The Zenodo record states CC BY 4.0, while the download page gives no separate licence notice. No geospatial file was downloaded or dilution value checked.
